links.outcome: Reliability and correlation of automated and semiautomated tools versus manual periorbital measurements on the same photos
links.effect: OrbitJ ICC and Pearson >0.8 versus manual; OrbitMap ICC and Pearson >0.5 except ISS; PeriOrbitAI ICC <0.5 except MRD2 and OCD, and failed on 6 images.
links.quote: Reliability between PeriOrbitAI and manual measurements was low (ICC <0.5) except for MRD2 and OCD, and correlation was moderate (Pearson correlation coefficient = 0.49-0.75).

screen.reason: The study compares human graders, a semi-automated ImageJ macro (OrbitJ), and two automated deep learning models (OrbitMap and PeriOrbitAI) for periorbital measurements on patient photographs to evaluate measurement agreement, reliability, and time-efficiency.
